from fractions import Fraction as F
import json, platform, sys
checks={}
a,b=F(3,2),F(5,2)
checks['energy_exponent_zero']=(2*a-3==0)
checks['time_convection_match']=(a+b==2*a+1)
checks['rescaled_viscosity_exponent']=(2-b==F(-1,2))
checks['speed_integral_exponent']=(a-b==-1)
checks['sqrt_time_exponent']=( -b/2==F(-5,4))
checks['speed_ratio_exponent_positive']=(a-b/2==F(1,4))
checks['dissipation_exponent_negative']=(2*(a+1)-3-b==F(-1,2))
r=[F(1,2**i) for i in range(10)]
t=[F(4,3)*x*x for x in r]
delta=F(1,2)
checks['geometric_time_steps'] = all(t[i]-t[i+1]==r[i]**2 for i in range(9))
checks['subwindows_contained'] = all(t[i]-delta*r[i]**2>=t[i+1] for i in range(9))
checks['geometric_radius_tail']=(sum(r,F(0))+2*r[-1]/2==2)
D=t[0]-t[-1]
S=delta*sum(r[:-1],F(0))
checks['finite_chain_radius_sum']=(S/delta==sum(r[:-1],F(0)))
checks['finite_chain_max_lower_bound']=(max(r[:-1])>=delta*D/S)
checks['pointwise_sqrt_modulus_squared'] = all(t[i]/r[i]**2==F(4,3) for i in range(10))
controls={
 'parabolic_clock_breaks_full_equation':(a+2!=2*a+1),
 'ns_amplitude_does_not_preserve_energy':(2*F(1)-3!=0),
 'long_window_not_contained':(t[0]-2*r[0]**2<t[1]),
 'long_windows_overlap':(max(t[0]-2*r[0]**2,t[1]-2*r[1]**2)<min(t[0],t[1])),
 'radius_bound_is_not_min_bound':(F(1,1024)<(1+F(1,1024)**2)/(1+F(1,1024)))
}
assert all(checks.values()) and all(controls.values())
print(json.dumps({'arithmetic_checks':checks,'negative_controls':controls,'counts':{'checks':len(checks),'controls':len(controls)},'environment':{'python':sys.version.split()[0],'platform':platform.platform(),'precision':'exact rational','parallelism':1},'scope':'Finite arithmetic and designated error controls only; not PDE, existence, limits, all interval inequalities, literature, novelty or publication certification.'},sort_keys=True,indent=2))
